title: サトノダイヤモンド登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond, heiress of the Satono Group, is set to make her debut in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her dream is to fulfill the Satono family's long-held dream of producing an illustrious runner capable of winning G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has garnered a great deal of attention from both her family and her fans. Still, she claims that fulfilling this wish is her dream and she doesn't feel pressured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has one other dream—racing in the Twinkle Series with Kitasan Black, a childhood friend who made her debut just recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the dreams and expectations of so many people on her shoulders, Satono Diamond's journey begins!
